title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report and physics source specify conservative perfect-gas NS equations, coefficients, Newtonian stress and Fourier heat flux.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS mixed-cell geometry, boundary families and cell-face topology are implemented.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-oriented cell-centred FV residual and global residual norms are source-supported.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov/LLF flux is implemented and described; it is deliberately diffusive rather than an entropy-fixed Roe method.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Characteristic farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths are documented and implemented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares linear reconstruction is active; the report candidly states pressure-sensor first-order face fallback and viscous-gradient coupling.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen limiter, sensor and positivity/rejected-update safeguards are source-supported.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Separate velocity/temperature gradients, Newtonian/Fourier terms and tangential skin-friction reporting are present; shock-gradient coupling limits formal confidence.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Local pseudo-time, rank-local LU-SGS/block-Jacobi Rusanov preconditioning and fully reassembled acceptance are implemented.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF1 startup/BDF2 frozen-history physical-time path and t=300 report evidence are present; Re200 was not rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbour halos are source-supported, but the reported NACA M0.15 np2/np8 order-one force mismatch makes the delivered MPI result invalid.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
